name_reason: Follows the game-function naming convention fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler' is the role (dispatched from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91). The '_2c' suffix is the dispatch-table index 0x2C, a meaningful domain ID -- NOT an address residue (it does not equal the function address 0x350a4 nor any data address; verified xref-to is the table slot at 0x51c41 which holds 0x350a4). '__ch19_ai_ctrl' accurately states chapter 19 + AI-control category (sets the per-event AI/dialog control flag to 3 for a char range). Consistent with sibling handlers 2b__ch18_ai_ctrl / 2d__ch19_ai_ctrl.
purpose: Chapter 19 turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x2C): arms the per-event AI/dialog control flag (low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD]) to 3 across runtime-char slots 0x1D..0x3B (31 chars), switching that NPC band's AI/dialog mode.
logic_summary: Single straight-line call: fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x1D, 0x3B, 3). No branches, no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used. In the original binary the handler pre-pushes all three args (start 0x1D, end 0x3B, flag 3) and JMPs (0x350B4 -> 0x34F39) into a class-3 shared tail hosted by fd2_chapter_event_handler_12 @ 0x34F02 ('CALL ...; ADD ESP,0xC; RET'); the C source reproduces the effect as a direct inline call for Layer-2 equivalence. Compiler-injected __CHK(0x10) stack probe.
